source_findings: Both binaries previously waited only for signals after readiness; an exited runner was not observed until signal-driven shutdown
Calling upstream iroh Server.shutdown after completing its Server.join would repoll the consumed supervisor handle; adapter must retain its outcome
First-error propagation could hide another failure during composed startup/cleanup
changes: Non-stopping canceled/repeated runner observers for Directory and owned Relay sharing retained join outcomes
RunningRelay observer caches upstream iroh supervisor result and avoids second poll at shutdown
Both binaries select runner termination and signals; host observes both services
Unexpected service completion triggers joined shutdown and failure exit, even when the runner returned successfully
Both cleanup failures retained; startup/signal-handler failures preserve cleanup context
regression: Cancel observer then prove real directory health / iroh TCP listener / owned relay attachment still work
Concurrent wait and close sends stop before runner lock, so observation cannot deadlock shutdown
Abort actual owned accept runner; repeated observe and close return same retained JoinError allocation, occupied state zero
Directory runner panic observed before controlled request and maintenance blocking jobs are released; fallback cancellation and final joins still work
Actual upstream iroh empty-service supervisor error observed twice then returned from shutdown without double poll
Completed owned runtime can be observed twice and shut down safely
Host status checker refuses unexpected clean exit and retains nested relay plus directory error causes
Existing actual binary SIGTERM, relay forwarding, restart and preflight suites remain in final matrix
limits: Observation signals runner completion, not stalled-task, worker-error or remote reachability health
No automatic restart/backoff or session recovery policy introduced
Directory failure observation does not wait for fallback disk work; actual close still waits for started filesystem calls
Upstream iroh owns its internal workers and panic cleanup; no stronger engine guarantee claimed
No native macOS or deployed SSH/desktop/sync/NAT qualification
No new dependency, wire version or external runtime helper; all waves open; cargo-deny unavailable
